This was the most high-end banchan I've

As we were leaving the restaurant, we
discovered another restaurant across the

I found this local katsu restaurant by

I think the last time I had katsu was
when I was living in Baltimore
over 15 years ago. I had it at a Korean

We are in West Hollywood at a restaurant

For my main dish, I ordered enchiladas.
It came with rice and black beans.

Overall, we had a great meal and I had a
